scripts.build: shx rm -rf build/ && vp build && npm run copy-libav && npm run build-jassub && npm run copy-html && npm run npm-package
scripts.copy-libav: shx cp node_modules/libav-wasm/build/worker.js build/libav-worker.js && shx cp node_modules/libav-wasm/build/libav.wasm build/libav.wasm && shx cp node_modules/libav-wasm/build/libav-jspi.wasm build/libav-jspi.wasm
scripts.copy-html: shx cp src/_headers build/_headers && shx cp src/index.html build/index.html && shx cp src/app.webmanifest build/app.webmanifest && shx cp README.md build/README.md && copyfiles -u 2 ./src/assets/* build/assets && node scripts/build-sw.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:local && npm run test:e2e:machine && npm run test:e2e:swarm
scripts.test:pause: npm run build && playwright test --project=chromium tests/stale-pause-flag.spec.ts
scripts.test:create: npm run build && playwright test --project=chromium tests/create-torrent.spec.ts
scripts.test:hybrid: npm run build && playwright test --project=chromium tests/hybrid-torrent.spec.ts tests/one-file-torrent.spec.ts
scripts.test:uptime: npm run build && playwright test --project=chromium tests/uptime-persists.spec.ts
scripts.test:eviction: npm run build && playwright test --project=chromium tests/storage-eviction.spec.ts
scripts.test:stream: npm run build && playwright test tests/stream-download.spec.ts
scripts.test:download: npm run build && playwright test --project=chromium tests/embed-download.spec.ts
scripts.test:multi: npm run build && playwright test tests/multi-tab.spec.ts
scripts.test:resume: npm run build && playwright test --project=chromium tests/resume-verify.spec.ts
scripts.test:contiguity: npm run build && playwright test --project=chromium tests/stream-contiguity.spec.ts
scripts.bench:ramp: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/torrent-ramp.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:local: playwright test --forbid-only --project=chromium tests/create-torrent.spec.ts tests/download-page-hold.spec.ts tests/download-share.spec.ts tests/embed-header.spec.ts tests/handover-rows.spec.ts tests/hints.spec.ts tests/hybrid-torrent.spec.ts tests/library-removals.spec.ts tests/long-name-copy.spec.ts tests/metadata-broadcast.spec.ts tests/multi-tab.spec.ts tests/one-file-torrent.spec.ts tests/rate-limits.spec.ts tests/smoke.spec.ts tests/stale-pause-flag.spec.ts tests/startup-list.spec.ts tests/stream-download.spec.ts tests/style-order.spec.ts tests/torrent-share-menu.spec.ts tests/uptime-persists.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:swarm: playwright test --forbid-only --project=chromium tests/embed-remote.spec.ts tests/embed-remote-autoplay.spec.ts tests/embed-download.spec.ts tests/resume-verify.spec.ts tests/startup-breakdown.spec.ts tests/storage-eviction.spec.ts tests/stream-contiguity.spec.ts tests/torrent-ramp.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:local: npm run build && npm run e2e:local
scripts.test:e2e:swarm: npm run build && npm run e2e:swarm
scripts.test:e2e:machine: npm run build && npm run e2e:machine
